invariants: Catalog content is immutable after construction: lookups only, no mutation methods; a policy change is a new catalog (frozen-at-startup, resolved 2026-11-26).
Lookups are by exact name within one project; an unknown project or name is None, never a default.
responsibilities: The typed catalog content: AgentProfile, Recipe, WorkflowPolicy, ProjectCatalog, and WorkCatalog with its lookup methods.
This is the Rust shape of what Python's WorkStore.catalog() produces from configuration.
summary: WorkCatalog: the frozen projects/profiles/recipes/workflow-policy reference data the admission path reads.
